# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## v2.15.3-aio.1 - 2026-05-20

### Features

- Package Penpot 2.15.3 as a single-container Unraid AIO image.
- Bundle frontend, backend, exporter, MCP, PostgreSQL, Redis-compatible cache, Nginx, and Mailpit.
- Generate and persist first-run secrets in `/appdata/config/generated.env`.
- Generate the Unraid template from a tracked upstream configuration inventory.
- Expose upstream Penpot environment variables and flags in Advanced View.
